climate.title: Climate related forcing
climate.description: Forcing data describing physical or chemical systems, in particular the climate, the oceans, and the cryosphere.

geo_conditions.title: Static geographic information

socioeconomic.title: Direct human forcing
socioeconomic.description: Independent additional forcing data, which influence climate impacts, such as land-use, population or economic changes.

default.description: For all experiments other than the sensitivity experiments.

1901co2.description: **CO₂ concentration fixed at 1901 levels** as a deviation from the `obsclim` climate + CO₂ forcing.

obsco2.description: **Observation-based CO₂ concentration** (as in `obsclim`) used with `counterclim` atmospheric forcing.

nowatermgt.description: **No water management** (e.g. no human water abstraction, no reservoirs) while other direct human forcings such as land use changes are considered according to `histsoc` or `2021soc`.

1901irr.description: **Fixed year-1901 irrigation areas and water use efficiencies** but representation of other direct human influences such as land use changes according to `histsoc`. This experiment is related to the IRRMIP initiative.

nofire.description: Simulation with **fire switched off** to identify impact of fire within the model.

extrasoc.description: Simulations with **additional direct human forcings**, such as desalination, inter-basin water transfer, and irrigation techniques share datasets.

vlndep.description: Nitrogen deposition according to the **Very Low emission scenario**.

hndep.description: Nitrogen deposition according to **High emission scenario**.

nondep2021co2.description: No nitrogen cycling and CO₂ concentration fixed at 2021 levels.

InputData.title: Input Data
InputData.description: The data used to drive the impact models, exactly as described in the ISIMIP simulation protocol.

SecondaryInputData.title: Secondary Input Data
SecondaryInputData.description: Data similar to or related to the input data, but not described in the simulation protocol (e.g. with a different spatial or temporal resolution).

DerivedInputData.title: Derived Input Data
DerivedInputData.description: Data derived from input data, typically for a specific publication.

OutputData.title: Output Data
OutputData.description: The climate-impacts simulation data provided by participating modelling groups, corresponding to the output variables described in the ISIMIP simulation protocol.

SecondaryOutputData.title: Secondary Output Data
SecondaryOutputData.description: Data that have been calculated by participating modelling groups, but does not correspond to output variables described in the simulation protocol.

DerivedOutputData.title: Derived Output Data
DerivedOutputData.description: Data not directly simulated by the impact models themselves, but rather, calculated (post-processed) from the model's outputs, typically for a specific publication.

histsoc.description: **Varying direct human influences** in the historical period.

1901soc.description: **Fixed year-1901 direct human influences** (e.g. land use, nitrogen deposition and fertilizer input, fishing effort).

2021soc.description: **Fixed year-2021 direct human influences** (e.g. land use, nitrogen deposition and fertilizer input, fishing effort).

2021soc-from-histsoc.description: **Fixed year-2021 direct human influences** (e.g. land use, nitrogen deposition and fertilizer input, fishing effort) for the future period, if the historical period was using varying direct human influences in the historical period.

ssp1vlsoc-adapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP1** and the **very low emission scenario**, accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp3hsoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP3** and the **high emission scenario**, not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp3hsoc-adapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP3** and the **high emission scenario**, accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp2lnsoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP2** and the **low-to-negative emission scenario**, not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp2lsoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP2** and the **low emission scenario**, not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp2mlsoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP2** and the **medium-to-low emission scenario**, not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp2msoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP2** and the **medium emission scenario**, not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp4xsoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP4** (no emission scenario corresponds to this SSP), not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

ssp5hlsoc-noadapt.description: Varying direct human influences in the future period according to **SSP5** and the **high-to-low emission scenario**, not accounting for the impact of climate change under the corresponding climate.

fullharm.title: Fully harmonized
fullharm.description: Simulations based on prescribed “present day” fertilization rates (available for download) and fixed planting and harvesting dates (also available for download). Modelers should have planting as closely as possible to these dates, but it may be admissible to use these dates as indicators for planting windows (depending on model specifics).

harmnon.title: Harmonized seasons with no N constraints
harmnon.description: For models with an explicit description of the nitrogen cycle: harmnon simulations should be run with nitrogen stress turned off completely or (if that’s not possible) with very high N application rates to make model results comparable between those GGCMs that have explicit N dynamics and those that do not. For models without the nitrogen cycle: harmnon and fullharm simulations are the same and do not need to be duplicated. Please contact the sector coordination to push on with this side branch.
